name: Integration request
about: Ask for support for an agent, framework, model SDK or witness

---

**What to integrate** (name, link, version)

**How it runs** (laptop coding agent, server-hosted agent, framework inside your app, ...)

**Where tool calls can be observed** (hooks, callbacks, an SDK client, a proxy, OpenTelemetry, ...)

**What you need recorded or enforced** (tool calls, model calls, approvals, policy blocks)

**Are you willing to help test it?**
